notes.title: Let's start again~
notes.content:
[h3]city of God is my first virgin indie game. Since steam was launched on March 7, 2017, the work, like the team, has experienced many ups and downs. It is loved and affirmed by many players. This is the driving force for me to continue this road, and also the biggest driving force for my creation[/h3]

The two works were transferred to Shengqu, and I bought them back this week. In the past three years, there has not been a day without hibernation waiting for this day. Fortunately, with the help of the team and the outside world, we survived and became stronger. Although our future is full of all kinds of variables, the only one that has not changed is always and forever a heart that hopes to continue to create "different" works for everyone. In line with this heart, I will continue to be cheeky for you, but also for myself to continue the game creation career. Although, I can't guarantee that I will make better works in the future. But at least, I will do my best.

That's the point. Let's talk about some things that we are concerned about

Q: will the city of God 1: Prison Empire be updated?
A: there will not be any new ways to play, but there may be some expanded content such as theme, storyline, etc. as appropriate.

Q: is there any news for city of God 2?
A: we plan to release the corresponding news in the third quarter of 2021, Goo Goo

Q: is there anything you can reveal about city of God 2?
A: the information now available is as follows: 1. Online 2. Survival 3. Doomsday 4. Firearms 5. Military mecha

Q: did you give up steam players?
A: before this week, the two works did not belong to me in the past few years. I have no right to issue any notice. But not in the future, because I have completed the buyback process. I'm sorry that I haven't heard anything from steam in recent years. Later, I expressed my apologies to you with actions. It's useless to say more.

Q: do you have any follow-up plans for the story of Railways?
A: the story of the railway is my favorite work. At present, the mobile version of the work is exclusively represented by "byte beat", while the switch version is also exclusively represented and distributed by Nintendo and Tencent. Steam version will carry out bug repair and game optimization in July. Meanwhile, new content and two free DLCs will be released in succession《 There may be more new contents in the future.

Q: what is your team doing now?
A: at present, we are fully developing a pixel survival work of takev like, which is expected to be published with you in the third quarter of this year. Goo Goo

Q: how much money do you have now? Will you run away after a few days?
A: over the past few years, I have been working hard to create games, and there has been no stagnation. As far as the current funds are concerned, it should not run away in the next two to three years. Please rest assured.

Q: when can Zhongxiong be bought or exchanged? Why did Zhongxiong group disband?
A: the exchange and purchase of Zhongxiong will be restarted next week (contact QQ 261897659). The owner of Zhongxiong group is Xiaoai. After the previous number was stolen, all the groups were disbanded and have been retrieved. Zhongxiong group will be reorganized in July.

Finally, in order to celebrate the success of COG and RW buyback, COG and RW have a 30% discount for a few days.

notes.title: [City of God I: Prison Empire] The second large DLC "Plague" notice!
notes.content:
[b]In the second large DLC [plague], you have become the largest and only gang leader in Crist. But not everyone is willing to surrender to you, you will be here to meet new challenges.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27701906/984e1c581df316cf3257f46fe8a35e0631107573.png[/img]

[h1]More stories[/h1]
·The story will happen after you unify Crist. (only in Empire Mode)
·A more than 2W word derivative story will reveal the story behind Natasha and the National Unity Party. Your choice will determine if you can understand the truth and don't miss every detail.
·The plague is coming, are you ready?

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27701906/c52b64b882224c6a056a285bba91b4b0b8b80766.png[/img]

[h1]New look building[/h1]
·Anubis City and Crist Building will no longer be what you know.
·A new kind of enemy, this is a special enemy that has never appeared before - the corpsemen.

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27701906/50e3982604d91ad003348f7ba46b78cc7f31053b.gif[/img]

[h1]Brand new prisoner[/h1]
·After completing a specific mission, your prison will welcome the special Blue Star consultant professional prisoner.
·They have their own stories, and they have unique abilities that far exceed the average consultant prisoner.
·When you get them at the same time, you can get a strong fetter - power of the Faithful Panda.

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27701906/722d00f48609187b6d52bfa83b79e42d1bcf263c.png[/img]

[h1]Use special weapons to deal with the special enemies[/h1]
Tramp and Dr.Reken's research will bring you brand new weapons or equipment, including
·Intensive weapons: The basic attributes are strengthened on the basis of the original weapons, which are more powerful but more difficult to obtain.
·AA-12 automatic shotgun: You can't imagine what kind of effect a shotgun has on the rifle's rate of fire. I suggest you can experience it yourself.
·11 type sniper grenade gun: High damage! High range! Range damage! Still need to say more?
·Chainsaw: For deal with the corpsemen, how can you not have the most classic chainsaw?

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27701906/da627d6e1d21e0550d48552af68077c83a0d982c.png[/img]

[h1]Top level[/h1]
·At the end of the DLC, You will welcome the hardest level ever - the Crist Building.
·Challenge higher floors and get more rewards!
·You will be able to get more intensive drawings here, and even the drawings of Tramp gold coins!
·If you are lucky enough to pass the level, there may be an unexpected surprise waiting for you.

notes.title: [Notice] Faithful Panda Fans owner and for purchase of part DLC's compensation
notes.content:
Notes on season tickets for Faithful Panda Fans(FPF)

1. After all the changes in DLC prices (after 0:00 on September 25, 2018), the channel for converting all DLCs into season tickets for Faithful Pnada Fans will be closed. This means that after that, you can't buy season tickets for faithful panda  fans by buying all DLC. (All paid DLCs other than the original DLC purchased at the previous price before that date are still convertible)

2. The season tickets for Faithful Panda fans will not be available through any STEAM channel, but only through our mail:Chief@pgcog.com

3. Faithful Panda Fans Season Ticket will remain at the original price of $38 US dollor, and will become a basis for more benefits to serve the core fans of PG Studio. In the future, we will also produce more Faithful Panda Limited DLCs to give fans more benefits.


All current and future compensation schemes for FPF are as follows:

1, all subsequent payment contents of COG1 will be free (at least not less than 3 paid DLCs) in the future.

2, additional free access to more FP DLCs (at least not less than 3 loyal bear DLC).

3. The first batch of free access to PG studio next simulation management + nurturing class of work "Railway Saga" KEY ontology.

4. Additional free access to "Railway Saga" specifically designed for FPF "Railway Saga" Limited FPF DLC KEY for  one.

5, the first batch of free COG sequel "City of God II: Sin City" KEY for one.

6. Get an extra free DLC KEY from "City of God II: Sin City" specially designed for loyal bear fans.

(putting COG2 in the last place is because she is still only a pie for now. I am not sure whether the studio can live to that day and make COG2. But please believe that we will try our best to make money in other ways to live that day and eventually put COG2 into practice.



After the season tickets for FPF stopped converting, players who bought some DLCs before then but did not become FPF will be compensated as follows:

1. After the closure of the FPF Season Ticket at 0:00 on September 25, 2018, if the LC you purchased separately had a price reduction or even free after the price change, we will make up for the cost reduction in the process of the adjustment in the form of DLC (adjusted price) that you did not get.

notes.title: [City of God - Prison Empire] World Cup Event and Follow-up Vehicle Modification Plan
notes.content:
Major updates:
1. Add World Cup Sneakers
A. Activity time: June 14th to July 15th, 2018
B. Players can play in three big casinos in the game during the Russian World Cup in 2018: Linden Street Caribbean Gamble, Harrison Road Franconian Casino and Ocean Avenue Anubis City 5th Floor Casino for World Cup lottery betting.
C. The winning team's football lottery can open and receive the special currency "Trump commemorative coin". More detailed information can be found in "World Cup Sneakers Description".
D. Players can learn about the content of the event and receive a "World Cup Sneaker Description" through a simple task "World Cup!" (Custom mode players can find this description in the warehouse)
2. Add the important currency "Trump commemorative coin"
A. The player can get the new props "Trump coin" for the first time in the World Cup.
B. The commemorative coin of Trump is divided into "copper", "silver" and "gold", and the conversion ratio is 1 gold = 10 silver = 100 copper coins.
C. Current Trump commemorative coins can only be obtained during the World Cup event. After the event ends, new acquisition methods will be added and will be dropped from the high difficulty levels in the game.
D. The "Trump Commemorative Coin" will be heavily used in the subsequent vehicle modification system.
3. Add new system "Car modification"
A. It is expected to open after the World Cup event and unlock the vehicle modification function through tasks.
B. Players can use the "Trump Commemorative Coin" and US dollars to change various effects on the vehicle in the garage, and the more powerful the function, the more "Trump Commemorative Coin" and the US dollar.

notes.title: New Mode Coming: Customized mode
notes.content:
In order to meet the demands of different players for difficulty, we plan to open a new game mode "custom mode" to players in the near future.
In this mode, players will be able to customize various game data according to the changes we have provided, such as difficulty and simplicity.
This mode will be independent of the plot and Empire mode, so the archive will not be able to connect to the other two modes.
At the same time, in order to speed up the player's game rhythm, there will be no plot events and government tasks and achievement goals in this mode.
All content that is open through the mission will be unlocked directly or through the player's discretion.
The specific introduction of the custom mode:
This mode is divided into four major modules: general settings, business settings, battle settings, and level settings.

[h1] In the normal settings, the player can set the following values ​​and functions: [/h1]
Initial funds
Initial prestige
Initial reputation
Initial product point
Initial operating point
Initial command point
Initial strategic point
Power supply facilities provide electricity
Initial office floor (up to 10 floors)
Initial floor of the prison area (up to 20 floors)
Initial underground floor (up to 10 floors)


[h1] In the business settings, players can set the following values ​​and functions: [/h1]
Initial market demand multiple
Initial prisoner mood multiple response
Initial prisoner health value multiples
Initial Prisoner Upgrade Speed ​​Multiplier
Initial prisoner's strength recovery factor
Initial tax rate
Unlock the whole picture
All NPCs in the City Like All 5 Hearts
Unlock all garment drawings
Unlock the furniture drawings
Unlock all electrical drawings
False drawings full unlock
Unlock the chemical drawings
Firearms drawings unlocked

[h1] In combat settings, players can set the following values ​​and functions: [/h1]
Original enemy gang AI style (crazy, aggressive, conservative, friendly)
Initial enemy and me leaders attack power
The upper limit of blood volume between the leaders of both the enemy and me
Initial enemy attacker attack power
Initial enemy and me beater blood cap
Sites yield multiple resource multiples
Initial Apocalypse Lab Study Point (DLC Limited)
Initial Forge House Study Point (DLC Limited)
Initial Arms Research Laboratory Research Point (DLC Limited)
Apocalypse Invasion Unlocked (All Enemy Allied Raiders Are Apocalypse Warriors) (DLC Qualified)

[h1] In the level settings, the player can set the following values ​​and functions: [/h1]
All levels NPC attack
All levels NPC blood volume
Level unlocking level increased
Levels can pause
Check whether the level is paused and unlocked
Level alarm increase

Other default enabled features:
1. The underground nuclear power station will be opened directly. If you choose the underground 10 floors, it will be on the 11th floor.
2. The maximum number of consultants is 5
3, all buildings are fully open
4, the highest building queue increased to 10
5. All building construction and upgrade time is shortened to 1 hour

[h1] This model plans to conduct the beta 2 test at the beginning of the next week and complete the online preparation. It is expected to go online with the official version at the end of May. [/h1]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0 Story Mode Updated Content
notes.content:
Changes in the story mode:
1. In different difficulty modes, you can now choose to pause (spacebar) when performing a level. Simple mode can be suspended 5 times, normal mode 3 times, difficult mode only 1 time.
2. In different difficulty modes, the simple mode and the normal mode will be suspended under the interface of cracking and unlocking. In difficult mode, the time to crack and unlock the interface will continue to flow.
3. New additions in simple mode: +300% for all product requirements; 50% reduction in alarm value for NPCs and triggered alarms in checkpoints.
4. Added in normal mode: the working efficiency of all processing plants increased by 200%; the alarm value after shooting in the level reduced by 50%.
5. In the difficult mode: The NPC's blood volume in the relevant card has increased by 300%; the game will initially come with a city effect of “Doomsday Prediction”.
6, the major banks LV4 ~ LV6 level safe will start low probability of falling: gold series of weapons; famous knives; advanced weapons; future shake and other rare items. After installing the "Fenglin Volcano", "Apocalypse Labs" and "Red Square Special Police" DLC, these levels will also drop corresponding weapons and equipment in the DLC.
7. A new system for prisoners' squatting has been added, and now a series of special effects will be activated after collecting prisoners in certain specific combinations. The system is equally effective in Empire mode.
8. A new package system has been added. Currently, only the equipment produced in the DLC has a suit effect. After that we will add some free packages in individual DLC. The system is equally effective in Empire mode.

notes.title: "City of God: Prison Empire" Official Version Version 1.0 Update Notice
notes.content:
Preface:
After one year, you can finally announce to all those who have purchased and wait and see, we are ready. Yes, on March 7 a year ago, we chose to barely go online due to our inability to face real-world pressure. Ultimately, the work that was in the test phase gave all the players who trusted us and purchased the artwork to support us and encountered a very bad game experience. Fortunately, after one year of restoration, optimization, and adjustment, the current version of COG has tended to be relatively stable and complete.
During the year, we joined many new systems and constantly adjusted and optimized various values ​​within the game. After more than 100 updates to the story version, it has now joined systems such as difficulty selection and novice achievement guidance. In addition to improving the plot model, we also added the "empire model" during the year. Players of this model will be able to form real gangs, recruit various levels of thugs, develop their own gang leaders (skills, characteristics, attributes, etc.), manipulate gang leaders and younger brothers to capture the city's main street locations and eliminate aliens. At the same time, you can also get a good relationship with other gangsters in the city through buyouts and gangs missions, check and balance each other so as to achieve your goal of ruling the whole city!
Empire mode and story mode will be two completely different games and experiences. As I mentioned before, although the PG Studio has been in a state of overstaffing in this year. However, this empire model will still not appear in the form of a charged DLC. This model will be included in the game itself. You will not need to pay extra for this purchase.
Finally, thanks to all the players who gave us advice, suggestions, and a lot of help during the year. The PG Studio will continue to spare no effort to create more fun works for you. Thanks~~ Orz
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27701906/07d2c4ac468acee827189037e218185d6b727296.png[/img]
"City of God: Prison Empire" official version Version 1.0 Update notice:
New content introduction:
Empire mode:
1, the new game mode Empire mode is turned on, the player will be able to directly enter the empire mode, you can also in the clearance of the 3 star difficulty x Samuel story mode after the story mode of some of the data inherited to the new empire mode.
2. We strongly recommend that you first pass through the 3-Star Difficulty story mode and then enter the Empire mode, because all gangsters in the Empire model will merge with each other over time and become progressively stronger. Therefore, it will become extremely important to be able to grab an opportunity by inheriting part of the plot archive.
3. The empire model is a continuation of the story after the end of the story mode. Players will play their role as governors after Samuel to survive and grow in the place where the gangs in Crest are everywhere.
4, the plot mode archive inheritance settings will announce the details in an announcement later.
5. In the Empire mode, we have newly added a personalized player customization system. Apart from allowing you to customize your appearance, you can also choose to have skin color, nationality, birth background, personality and life experience. These choices will affect the relationships in future games. For example, when you choose the color of the skin to be yellow, then the relationship between you and the Chinese gang Hongwumen will be congenital.
6. A new target system has been added. After entering the empire mode, the player can obtain a temporary bonus by selecting his own game target. After achieving these goals in life, you will receive many permanent bonuses. Of course, the addition may also have negative effects on other aspects. Players need to consider their own merits and weigh the pros and cons.
7. The characteristics of the prisoners are redefined, and the previous features are weak. After the Empire model was launched, we added a large number of new features, and many old features have also been improved and optimized. In addition to affecting the mood of prisoners, some of the features will now affect their new features such as maximum blood volume, loyalty, and processing efficiency.
8. With the addition of the Position Warfare System, you will be able to directly control your gang leader and lead your gang fighters to gang gangs in various neighborhoods. Each gang leader has unique talent skills and active and passive skills. At the time of the stronghold, you can control or reverse the war situation by grasping the opportunity to release each skill. At the same time, morale values ​​need to be watched during the war. A thug is not killed or killed. The morale of both sides will change. The value of morale affects the important combat attributes such as the strength and defensive strength of friendly forces.
9. More than 100 new items have been added, including various resource and item resource boxes, various types of gold weapons, high-intensity cold weapon Guan Gong, and Yaodao Village. At the same time, more than 20 new armor sets have been added, and these new armor sets will also have a decisive influence on the base points and various levels. (The new armor will fall within the Advanced Stealing Level and all Robbery Levels)
10. Newly added more than 40 new vehicles and more than 30 new vehicle skills, including a new type of air carrier-flying boat. All new vehicles will appear as DLC. Some are free DLC, some are paid DLC.
11. Added more than 200 gang leaders to prisoners, half of whom were gang leaders of NPC gangs (the organic rate was recruited after defeat) and the other half could be obtained by completing a clue task, delivering a prisoner, or completing a goal.
12. 31 new positions have been added. Players can occupy the gangs in each block by taking or buying. After occupying these strongholds, the stronghold will continue to produce the resources of this stronghold. But be careful, gangsters who have a poor relationship with you are watching the fat in your mouth and they may attack you at any time.

special reminder:
Due to the more updated contents of this empire model, the documents are larger. Please check the integrity of the next game after the download is complete. In the past year, we have found that most of the players who have crashed or other serious problems are from the incomplete download of the game client. After the 100% download is completed, the corresponding problem will be resolved.

After the new version comes online, you will still encounter some bugs. After encountering BUG, ​​please contact the development team in time.

tags.feature: Empire mode: 1, the new game mode Empire mode is turned on, the player will be able to directly enter the empire mode, you can also in the clearance of the 3 star difficulty x Samuel story mode after the story mode of some of the data inherited to the new empire mode.

5. In the Empire mode, we have newly added a personalized player customization system. Apart from allowing you to customize your appearance, you can also choose to have skin color, nationality, birth background, personality and life experience. These choices will affect the relationships in future games. For example, when you choose the color of the skin to be yellow, then the relationship between you and the Chinese gang Hongwumen will be congenital.

6. A new target system has been added. After entering the empire mode, the player can obtain a temporary bonus by selecting his own game target. After achieving these goals in life, you will receive many permanent bonuses. Of course, the addition may also have negative effects on other aspects. Players need to consider their own merits and weigh the pros and cons.

7. The characteristics of the prisoners are redefined, and the previous features are weak. After the Empire model was launched, we added a large number of new features, and many old features have also been improved and optimized. In addition to affecting the mood of prisoners, some of the features will now affect their new features such as maximum blood volume, loyalty, and processing efficiency.

8. With the addition of the Position Warfare System, you will be able to directly control your gang leader and lead your gang fighters to gang gangs in various neighborhoods. Each gang leader has unique talent skills and active and passive skills. At the time of the stronghold, you can control or reverse the war situation by grasping the opportunity to release each skill. At the same time, morale values ​​need to be watched during the war. A thug is not killed or killed. The morale of both sides will change. The value of morale affects the important combat attributes such as the strength and defensive strength of friendly forces.

9. More than 100 new items have been added, including various resource and item resource boxes, various types of gold weapons, high-intensity cold weapon Guan Gong, and Yaodao Village. At the same time, more than 20 new armor sets have been added, and these new armor sets will also have a decisive influence on the base points and various levels. (The new armor will fall within the Advanced Stealing Level and all Robbery Levels)

10. Newly added more than 40 new vehicles and more than 30 new vehicle skills, including a new type of air carrier-flying boat. All new vehicles will appear as DLC. Some are free DLC, some are paid DLC.

11. Added more than 200 gang leaders to prisoners, half of whom were gang leaders of NPC gangs (the organic rate was recruited after defeat) and the other half could be obtained by completing a clue task, delivering a prisoner, or completing a goal.

12. 31 new positions have been added. Players can occupy the gangs in each block by taking or buying. After occupying these strongholds, the stronghold will continue to produce the resources of this stronghold. But be careful, gangsters who have a poor relationship with you are watching the fat in your mouth and they may attack you at any time.

notes.title: Version 0.863 Hotfix Update (beta2)
notes.content:
Fix BUG:
1. Fixed a bug that could not be retrieved due to a missing file that saved the wrong data.
2. Fixed the "break with hell" Assassination mission to complete the task after the completion of the submission point BUG.
3. Repaired the release of prisoners in transit, the prisoners will be stuck in prison, resulting in the prison there is a vacancy can not recruit new prisoners in the prisoner's BUG.
4. Repair the level of the money will become money props BUG, ​​now the money obtained in the level will directly load the total assets of the warden, the original money items should be placed on the back of the governor backpack with TAB The use of shortcuts.
5. Fix the prisoners move in the level at the same time click on the item search button, the Prisoner search items but will continue to move forward BUG.
6. Fixed BUG after developing automatic incineration technology, trash burning after the garbage enters the incinerator but not burning animation in the incinerator.
7. Fixed Blacksmith carrying money and the actual amount of money available to sell the BUG.
8. Fixed a bug in the robbery level where prisoners stuck in checkpoints were convoked by a convocation of prisoners.
9. Fixed robbery level looting items obtained after the end of the level will not be automatically put into the warehouse BUG.
10. Fixed the bug that the props will not disappear when the number of level props, such as consumption keys, in the robbery level is zero.
11. Fixed some bars in the night bar stuck in the door BUG.
12. Fixed bug where the efficiency of research points did not improve after adjustment.
13. Fixed the first chapter to provide the Ammunition mission task prompt box and mission requirements items different BUG.

optimization:
1. Reduce the Night Bar, Johnson Pharmaceutical Factory, Chemical Factory, Stone Private Clinic password cracking difficulty.
2. An additional radiation protection technology has been added to upgrade this technology to reduce the impact of nuclear radiation on nuclear power plant operations.
3. To customize the car after the completion of the prompt mail to increase the street, store tips to facilitate the governor to find the car's pickup address.
4. For prisons operation and maintenance of science and technology in the prison cleaning, patrolling martial law, the control idea added after the upgrade technology will not be able to upgrade again prompted.
5. Now roller wheel in the commodity selection processing interface will not affect other processing, such as scroll bar interface.
6. Add tips for robberies that prisoners can not pick up items when they rob the backpack full.
7. The Police Station Administration has been changed from 12 Garden Road Police Station to 2 Ston Street Police Station.

notes.title: Version 0.857 Hotfix更新内容（beta2）
notes.content:
修复BUG:
1.修复了在主线第六章-莉莉娅·娜塔莎事件中，出现图片缺失的bug。
2.修复了“电脑精通”科技位置和前置科技显示错误的bug。
3.修复了在“拯救江南皮革厂”事件完成后无法与对应NPC对话的bug。
4.修复了卡里路纺织厂的厂长NPC，对话与实际喜好不符的bug。
5.修复了斯通诊所3楼人物不能被攻击的BUG。
6.修复了斯通诊所难度4以上的三楼蜂鸣器无效的BUG。
7.修复了使用过的武器可以无限出售的BUG。
8.修复了耐久度消耗时会产生新物品的BUG。
9.修复了事件关卡中，点击撤退会导致画面卡死不动的bug。
10.修复了在和NPC提交事件前点暂停，对话结束后，场景会变暗淡，无法和其他NPC对话的bug。
11.修复了在最后一战中，死亡后按空格仍然会出现复活弹窗的bug。

优化：
1.修正了在“旅游巴士路线3”事件的对话提示，该NPC需要在任务完成后达成好感度才可定制车辆。
2.优化了大部分武器的耐久度。
3.现在在关卡中会自动替换装备，会优先替换上耐久度低的装备。
4.现在在玩家与黑商交易时，每卖出50000美元或额外获得1点威望。
5.优化了黑商的交易窗口，现在可以直接在该窗口查看到当前出售物品的总价。
6.优化了关卡中自动更换武器的规则，现在枪械耐久耗尽后，会自动切换上消耗了耐久并且等级最高的武器。

我们会及时收集并处理你所反馈的信息。

notes.title: Version 0.839 Hotfix 更新内容（beta2）
notes.content:
优化：
1、增加了一个[需求指定职业囚犯]的功能。玩家可以在囚车到达时，点击押送警察花费金钱来选择一个职业，下次囚车到达时押送囚车会送来对应职业的囚犯，这个功能一周只能使用一次。
2、优化了“合作”事件中信托银行的关卡提示。

1、修复了在典狱长外出前采购原料，原料车会延迟把原料送达监狱的BUG。

3、修复了在偷窃关卡中，敌对NPC会卡在楼梯的BUG。
4、修复了在药店股份100%的情况下在监狱中倒地的囚犯无法自动购买药品的BUG。
5、修复了黑商物品可以通过读取存档无限刷新的BUG。

notes.title: COG FAQ 3 SEASON
notes.content:
COG, the third quarter FAQ [hot questions reply highlights]

Hello everyone, I'm Chief. Since the COG has been released since the past six months. This six months we PG studio to do something, what effect, the future and ready to do? How to do it? These players are particularly concerned about the issue, I will be in this FAQ to do a unified reply. I hope this will help you.

(All of the following questions are from the player questions)

[h1] players A: Will you work in the end of this six months in the workplace? Is not getting our money is not ready to continue to do? [/ h1]
Chief: Since March 7 on the line, we probably spent a full three months is a variety of BUG, ​​crash, flashback fight. Eventually we pass the 100 days to solve most of the problems and optimize the completion. Of course, there may be some BUG, ​​but these BUG should be on the line and the initial BUG amount can not be the same language. After that 3 months, we are basically in the perfect plot of the various new systems and new content. Such as event system, black exchange system, carrier system and so on. And the story is exactly what the three months to complete. In simple terms, we spent the first three months to solve most of the BUG, ​​optimizing a number of anti-human defects (of course, there are some places also need to continue to optimize). It took three months to complete all the new content and the new system in all the plot patterns.

[h1] player B: sandbox mode in the end when will be out? [/ h1]
Chief: By the end of August we vote on the players group results show that the vast majority of players look forward to the sandbox model rather than disaster mode. So in early September we decided to play the disaster pattern from the ontology removed, fully into the sandbox mode of development work, as soon as possible so that everyone play to the sandbox mode. So, sandbox mode is expected to meet with you this year.


[h1] player C: what new elements will appear in sandbox mode? [/ h1]
Chief: According to the current sandbox model of the overall prototype design point of view, in addition to the plot mode has some of the system, the sandbox mode will also join the new combat mode (players can control the role of shooting), the new trajectory and weapons System, the new gang battle system, the influence of the street system. But it is worth mentioning that the sandbox mode will not appear in any story mode event task. In addition, the sandbox mode is open mode. That does not require players plot mode clearance, ready to open the mode of play. Finally, in the sandbox mode, the player can create the protagonist himself. From the color, hair, hair color, eyes, pupil color, to the beard, under the beard, mask, decoration can be designed by the player DIY.


[h1] player D: when this game is considered the official version? [/ h1]
Chief: The current version of the sandbox mode is 0.9X. So, after the sandbox mode is complete (and fixes a lot of BUG) will officially end EA, upgrade to the official version.


[h1] Player E: How long will the studio work? Will not do half off the road, right? [/ h1]
Chief: Not long after, but it will be done in sandbox mode. Do not worry.


[h1] Player C: Why are i in the community you are regardless of us? [/ h1]
Chief: First of all to the community, paste it in the post to ask you a great apology. Indeed, we did not spend too much energy on community operations because I thought community operations required at least one full-time team member to maintain. And this point for our four small team is too much for the luxury. So, we are now beginning to take time every day to collect the problem in the community, and then unified response and resolution.


[h1] players F: why do you come out of each version of the team have so many BUG? [/ h1]
Chief: Indeed, so much BUG comes mainly from our lack of rigorous testing process. Or that we can not put more manpower and time on the test. Game content and our staff is not proportional to the amount of content overload, but also lead to the entire game more than 10,000 test points. I remember last year at the Sony Developer Conference, we and a Japanese professional game testing agencies to communicate for a while. When we put the game ontology (then only 0.5 version) to them, let them estimate the time after. They actually told us that you need a full 1000 hours of testing / artificial. However, after six months, we finally understand that their 1000 hours of testing / labor is not without reason.


[h1] player G: You do the game idea is very good, but it is too big to feel you fill the pit on this. [/ h1]
Chief: If Jingwei fill in your house in front of a small pond, then he also called Jingwei it? If the foolish move is behind his house that small mound, then whether we will know that there are so foolishness in the world? PG studio, the future of the basic game will be based on this background stage design and development. Pit black and black repair Xi Xi, let me use this life to fill the so-called "pit" it


[h1] player H: I almost every day waiting for the update, why do you need 3 to 4 days to update once. Can not be more frequent? [/ h1]
Chief: This is our fastest speed, it is not fast, sorry.

[h1] player F: COG will be online version? [/ h1]
Chief: You had this idea before, but in the short term our team was temporarily unable to realize. So, at least in the first generation of COG this work we still do not have a good idea to network him. BTW: I do not want to be a warden war game out, I think this kind of business class is not fun. (personal opinion)

notes.title: Version 0.813 Hotfix 更新内容
notes.content:
优化：
1、降低了所有关卡NPC的伤害。
2、核电机房、爆破训练中心以及开锁训练中心等建筑增加开关功能。
3、缩短了所有成品及物料的加工时间（造假成品除外）。
4、初始威望被提高。
5、优化了新存档首次弹出的快捷键提示界面。
6、囚犯信息界面增加了顾问职业的详细说明的悬浮提示。
7、囚犯信息界面增加了囚犯当前状态的显示。
8、优化了囚犯被抓信件的文字，在文字中增加了警局的地址提示。
9、优化了“牛仔夙愿”任务的文字提示。
10、降低了“清理门户”事件关卡的难度。
11、现在对3种存在的牛仔裤进行了重新命名分别是“Jeans牛仔裤”“Glenn牛仔裤”“牛仔裤”，只有服装加工厂才能生产“牛仔裤”。
12、现在夜色酒吧老板觉得步枪不符合他的身份，改为佩戴左轮手枪了。

BUG修复：
1、修复了被格斗家击晕的NPC，受到伤害不会醒来的问题。
2、修复了事件“请帮帮我”完成内容地址显示不对的问题。
3、修复了部分事件对话内容中，关键词显示不正确的问题。
4、修复了路易斯药店，有时进门后会卡住的问题。

notes.title: Version 0.809 Hotfix 更新内容
notes.content:
优化：
1、提高了低级格斗家击晕的时间。
2、再一次提高了初级原材料的采购量。
3、所有服装、家具类成品出售价及需求量提高20%，电器出售价及需求量提高10%。
4、现在，政府任务奖励的美金亦将不再计入税收范围之内。
5、现在高难度的银行会提供最低的通关金额。
6、现在打开首饰盒、表盒等道具出现的界面只有确定按钮了，典狱长物品栏已满的情况下在监狱中开启道具多出的物品会自动放入仓库中，如果在街道上开启道具多出的物品会被直接丢弃。
7、现在制造成品时，材料不足的时候也将显示所需材料数量。

修复BUG：
1、修复了普通关卡消耗情报单并且完成之后不增加次数的问题。
2、修复了事件对话界面出现乱码的问题。
3、修复了部分玩家没办法完成事件“娜塔莎的叔叔”的问题。
4、修复了部分玩家“除掉叛徒”事件，无法提交的问题。
5、修复了“一丝希望”事件，没办法偷到“医学笔记”的问题。
6、修复了商品出售界面成本价格和出售价格一样的问题。
7、修复了"红雀路3号"错误显示为"红雀路1号"的问题
8、修复了红雀路3号事件关卡没有目标NPC的问题

notes.title: STM Version 0.78 Update Content
notes.content:
Optimized updating:
1, the increase is the last one of the biggest hurdles: stealing Crist trust bank!
2, the number of factory work has been adjusted:
The ground factory 1-9 can accommodate 3 people; underground workshop 1-3 can accommodate 1 people, 4-6 to accommodate 2 people, 7-9 to accommodate 3 people. Now, all 10 factories can accommodate four prisoners and work together.
Now, the upgrading of the 9-10 level needs "factory expansion permit" or "workshop expansion design"".
These two props are scattered among the banks of Chris. At the same time, according to hearsay, Hoffman metallurgical factory and Smith metallurgical factory boss from time to time will sell these two props.
3, the number of people in gyms and libraries has been expanded. The library is full of 6 people, and the gym is full of 5 people. Now, these two buildings will gradually increase the number of people as the grade increases.
4, nuclear reactors now add fuel consumption status indicators, while fixing the amount of fuel filling in nuclear power plants.
5, the instruction function of the prison guide icon has been adjusted.
6, in order to tie in with the upcoming scenario, we rearrange the order of government tasks, and the number of tasks has been drastically reduced.
7, the new carrier system:
From now on you can buy or customize your favorite car in a car store. Custom cars have better performance and, of course, cost more money and time. Better visibility will unlock more advanced vehicles.
Each car now has different attributes, such as vehicle type, speed, fuel consumption, number of passengers, capacity of portable goods, fuel consumption and special effects, etc.. These will affect the performance of the state, the purchase and sale of the factory, even for the gang members to perform the task to provide more convenience!
You can sell unused cars in the garage to the car for recycling, NPC. But the price of car recycling...... Everyone is a businessman, you know!
Now, you can upgrade the underground garage to unlock larger parking spaces to facilitate the parking of different types of cars. When the garage reaches a certain level, it can unlock the auto repair function! Keep your car from aging because it has been parked too long!
Now when your car is out of order. With only 1 calls, the taxi driver will take you to wherever you want to go. Of course, none of this is free......
And when your vehicle in the street damage broke down how to do? Just 1 calls, Towing Co will help you solve everything. Of course！ It's not free, either......
Now, 9-10 needs to upgrade the garage garage expansion design". Our intelligence has been told that a house is being built in Wood street and a super garage is being built!
BUG repair
1, fix the prison drug Bureau, casinos, canteens and other buildings at the entrance, prisoners stuck problem.
2, the repair of the Lewis raw material chemical plant safety box opens, still pop-up pop-up button BUG.
3, repair the level, ready interface, you can copy the equipment BUG.
4, the game appeared in the full keyboard failure BUG was repaired.
5. Fixed the BUG in the barrier where the prisoner fell to the ground after the battle fell.
6, fixed the passive NPC in the checkpoint after being knocked down and escaped BUG.
7, repaired the Wood NPC villa 7, after the attack, left BUG.
8, the repair of the nuclear power plant interface "add fuel scroll bar" drag invalid problem.
9, repair Harrison Road, little cat, strip bar, NPC no sales problems.
10, repair the park road Luis garment factory, the German electrical workers out of Norfolk street room BUG.
11, fixed the community bank master switch invalid BUG.
12, repaired the passive NPC immediately after the stun, BUG.
13, fixed the number of actual arrest and the number of mail prompts inconsistent after the end of the BUG.
As carrier systems are more numerous, the problem will be much larger than expected (partial carrier functions will increase in the 0.78 series HOTFIX). If BUG please group BUG collectors report.

notes.title: STM Version 0.77 Update Content
notes.content:
Add and optimize:
1, increase the three stealing points: Bedford Street Wisteria Bank, Garden Road National Unity Club, Lakewood Road, No. 7 villa. The three stealing levels are the most difficult for the three stealing levels. The last hurdle "Cristo is a trust bank" will be released in version 0.78.
2, "prison management guide" on the line, you can click on the screen at the top of the question mark to get more prison management experience and methods.
3, distinguish between the level of active NPC and passive NPC blood bar color, blue blood for the passive NPC, red blood to take the initiative NPC.
4, the factory material filter switch is now automatically default to open.
5, the power generation of nuclear reactors were optimized.
6, to increase the continuous research function of science and technology, it can help you continue to study those who can upgrade several times the technology.
7, to optimize the prison gang recruitment of dialogue bubbles, and now the props will not be beyond the border.
8, the original novice task of "building air conditioning and garbage room" to "have 50W deposit".
9, now the warden in the process of shopping can be suspended (dining, drinking, pops can not be suspended).
10, the new addition of the second quarter "players DIY prisoners" finalists of 13 prisoners.

Fix bugs:
1, revised the new guide in the "training 3 tailor" task, now as long as there are three tailors to complete.
2, restored the barber hair coloring function. Now we can normal hair and dye beard.
3, to repair the robbery level, the police can not grasp the prisoners of the BUG.
4, to repair the government after the completion of the task will still receive a new task tips BUG
5, repair the Lakewood Street department store top floor room stuck BUG.
6, the restoration of the Pacific Road, no matter where the front desk prostitutes function.
7, repair the Louis Jones 3 incident, donated armor after the completion of the task did not get prestige reward BUG.
8, repair the sofa price display error.

    This game is a reference to the prison architect and research and development of the game, but the game set a lot of flashy all kinds of imbalance and not a permanent cure, such as has been to improve the difficulty of making money, the full level of chemical plants from three people can accommodate 2 people, chemical drugs and military firearms finished products required to improve the material to 200%, I heard that the test version also fake finished product output time longer.

3, to increase the difficulty is not a way to increase the game, but the content of these changes is not to simply increase the difficulty of the game. notes.title: May Plot full version 0.7 ~ 0.8 version of the content and test notice
notes.content:
Because we have more content in May, we plan to release all the newly opened content through the Story Test Mode (STM) version.
0.7 Version Definition:
This version is an overdue version of the full version of the story, which is a version of all story-related systems. The series will only appear in the STM (Story Test Mode), will never be in the official version of the line.

0.8 version definition:
The version of the story for the full version, which defeated all the scenes required scripts, events, dialogue and other content. This version will eventually appear in the official version after the test is complete.


0.7 version of the content:
Big map all the streets, all the buildings, most of the features

Which will be directly open as follows 26 streets:
Cali Road, Blues Road, Highland Road, Taylor Road, Stone Street, Newark Street, Harrison Road, Hakanta Road, Oak Street, Cardinal Road, Hobart Road, Park Road, Walking Bay Street , Man Tung Street, Lamb Wood Street, Norfolk Street, Bedford Street, Pacific Road, Turin Road, Lakewood Road, Tilden Street, Nanshan Road, Garden Road, Central Avenue, Manning Street Ocean Avenue

Open nearly 200 buildings, including but not limited to:
Anubis City, Grand City, Trump Tower, Greenfield Police, Rockwell Police, Urban Police, several banks of varying sizes, a large number of nightclubs, strip clubs, bars and massage parlors, A large number of colored restaurants, several barber shops, global chain cafes, a large number of shops and grocery stores and other buildings.
Which will include: Black Cloud Aquarium, Cristo City Museum of History, San Juan Opera House, San Juan Department Store, St. Juan Cathedral

Add level:
A total of more than 30 new stealing levels will begin testing in May
Robbery play on the line, the new robbery jewelry store and community bank level, follow-up all the banks will be able to rob in the plot mode.
Note: robbery and theft are different, to be controlled at the same time, and hostage to intimidation and intimidation.

new features:
All police officers are redeemable to arrest prisoners
All police officers may refresh the prisoners (subject to value 100)
Can be changed in the barber shop hair, color
You can change the beard style and color in the barber shop
A strip of dancers can provide a one-to-one service
Ticketing system (for entry into the Black Ocean Museum, Grand Theater, etc.)
Membership card system (for access to Anubis City, Yamato City, small Italy and other high-end club)
Robbery play

Interface optimization:
Prisoner information summary interface revision (now available in the interface for all prisoners)

0.8 version of the content:
Complete story event
Multiple game lines (new feature lines, legendary prison line will be open in the 0.8x series)


Due to open more content in May, the amount of information is large, it is strongly recommended game time more than 100 hours of the players into the test. So as to avoid the confusion and burden of your normal gaming experience.

notes.title: "City of God: Prison Empire" follow-up version of the update plan
notes.content:
[h1]1, Version 0.7 before the final content update: Add six levels:
     6 new levels will be released next week in the BETA version. Including the (Cardinal Road residential, Oak Street residential, Carrie Road mills, Carrie Wooden Plant, Hobart Street Louis Chemical Materials Factory and Luis Chemical Processing Plant) take into account the new level is not currently open Of the neighborhood, so there may be individual problems in the theft process. Please feel free to send us feedback after finding the problem.

2, on the future update rhythm:
The future in our Hotfix update will no longer have any new content appears, the daily Hotfix will be to repair BUG and optimization experience based.
The next time the content updates, we will release the entire "story mode" when. Which includes the story with the gradual opening of more than 30 blocks, all kinds of characteristics of the building, as well as hundreds of new drama task. This phase is expected to take 30 to 60 days. After the plot mode is complete, we will be open in the BETA version and for everyone to test in advance.

3, on the sandbox mode:
The entire design of the sandbox model will be completed in April, due to the completion of the entire city infrastructure. Therefore, the first half of this year to complete the entire sandbox mode and survival mode is very likely.
What can I do in sandboxed mode?
Street occupation, the sale of vehicles (perhaps in the plot mode to join), gang war, robbery, theft and other games are played.
The ultimate goal of the sandbox model is to rule the entire city of Cristo

4, my follow-up work plan:
We have been through the 2 weeks to solve the game there are most of the problems. Next, in addition to continuing to repair and optimize the work itself. I will re-sort the game in all the finished product manufacturing time, cost, price, demand and the impact of urban conditions on their respective. At the same time will further improve the novice guidance and government tasks. The plot will be completed in mid-April to the initial load, as far as possible in April to complete and publish to the BETA version.

Thank you for your support and love! Thank you for each of your suggestions and criticisms!
Please look forward to the "God of the City: Prison Empire" Version 0.7 full version of the story mode to come.[/h1]

notes.title: Warden's FAQ first season
notes.content:
In the week after the EA, we will focus on most of the warden's common problems. Made the first quarter of the FAQ, hoping to help you warden.

[h1] Players: When is the rush?
Chief: In the sandbox mode will have Rush, grab the site and other gang war, we plan to complete the plot mode and then add the sandbox mode. Plot mode is expected to be completed within this month.

Players: why not open the first rush?
Chief: We hope that you will be familiar with the whole story of the entire city of Crete, gangs, shops, people and other background after the sandbox mode of the gang war.

Player: why not open a novice mode? The current model is too hard.
Chief: Unfortunately, we did not intend to open the novice mode at this stage. But will appear in the official version similar to the novice teaching model. So that the new warden can get started quickly.

Players: Can you consider that pawnshops are not included in the tax collection?
Chief: The idea is great, I have made the adjustment in the 0.562 version, and now there is no tax rate for the sale of all items in the pawnshop.

Players: crash, do not work when the problem can be completely resolved?
Chief: The crash is still collecting all the error messages, which may take some time, but I am confident that the problem has been improved in the near future. And work problems have been found in the early morning of the important clues, I believe that this week can be completely resolved. If not solve me, no! Is our main program live to eat Xiang.

Players: Can you consider setting up a city library where all the books can be read and then put the history of the city and the introduction of the gang into these books?
Chief: Great idea, in fact we have added dozens of books in the game. At present these books can only be used as a warden for learning (to increase the number of research points). But we have recently tried to guide the novice to the "prison management manual" into the game warden's backpack, which means that in the future there may be similar forms of books appear in the game.

Players: Can you increase the facilities for the sale of prisoners or prisoners?
Chief: The former can be considered, the latter I need to be quiet.

Players: Can a prisoner be executed?
Although this means is not human, lack of human nature. But it is undeniable that this is PG studio favorite routines. So the court should be in the near future to meet with you.

Player: Why is it so little outside the theft?
Chief: The game has a total of more than 50 size points (including the robbery level and hidden level), we are currently 4 to 5 a week to add the speed. The future of the new level will be ahead of the BETA version of the first to log in and test for some time.

Players: why the library project needs so many books do not get?
Chief: There are dozens of books in the game, but in fact I do not want to put all the books in the beginning to the few streets and hurdles. So please be patient waiting for subsequent levels and versions. We apologize here for having obsessive-compulsive disorder. Orz

Players: your BUG really much, why not change the main course?
Our team has three or four years together, and everyone is together to support each other today. BUG more or my main pot, pit dig too much. Need time to fill slowly

Players: Now the game basically rely on fraud to make money, very unbalanced. This is boring.
Chief: The new version of the workshop will be a balanced version of the workshop will be open this week or next week to the BETA version. When the chemical plant drugs will become the most cost-effective goods, but the risk is also larger (affected by the city situation). All weapons in the mall can be equipped with prisoners (by occupational distinction). All counterfeit handicrafts in the fake factory will be the longest and most profitable commodity.

Players: when can open more maps ah?
Chief: The follow-up map will be open with the follow-up drama chapter, now we can design a good "egg" to go to some locked blocks.

Players: every time a prisoner sent are fixed, is not BUG?
Chief: For the new warden, whether it is a tailor or carpenter, are very important. So we will fix a tailor and carpenter at the beginning for everyone to choose. If you do not need, you can offer after the release.

Players: Will you ask if you are in the studio?
Chief: Taking into account the pit so big, the technology on the two. So we welcome the enthusiastic programmer and inspirational to become the game designer you join our team. Chief@pixelgangsta.studio [/h1]

notes.title: 3/7 HotFix update content
notes.content:
Write in front of some words:
Today is the first day we are on the line, we are fortunate that there are many players to praise the works. But this does not make us happy, because we are very clear that the game still has many need to improve, perfect, optimize the place. We know more clearly, the work did not reach many praise supporters look, but thank you can continue to give us encouragement and support.

March 7 first day on-line update content

1, reducing the risk of skin disease and lung disease, and now all prisoners in the garbage when the reduction of skin diseases and lung disease health decreased a lot.
2, now the Aegean massage parlors and bars can solve your "low" and "anxiety" state.
3, the loan income will no longer be included in the scope of tax collection.
4, when the finished product will be displayed when the finished product icon, but not the material icon.
5, the infirmary drugs are now all displayed, in the absence of the case will be gray.
6, full-screen state, delete the record pop-up problem has been fixed.
7, in the individual resolution window mode point of the problem has been fixed. (If there are similar problems, you can modify the root directory SceneConfig.txt file)
8, now accept the prisoner's interface can be dragged, click on the rest of the other can close the current interface.
9, to solve the demolition of prisoners when the logic of the problem, now as long as the prison has spare space to remove the cell.
10, the addition of accelerated shortcut keys F1 = original speed F2 = 2 times speed F3 = 3 times the speed, while the corresponding display at the same time.
11, to solve the prisoners will not go to work, if it will happen please contact me in time.
12, to solve the prisoners at the door of the problem.
13, slightly reduced the rate of decline in the warden's mood.
14, slightly raised the efficiency of the warden and a small amount of reduced physical exertion.
15, to enhance the government to achieve the task of the amount of prestige.
16, due to complaints from nearby residents, the prisoners are now more patient patience will no longer be frequent horn.
17, today "Onham Street" on the "Judy" will begin selling all kinds of pharmaceuticals, which can ease the warden of your body's various discomfort.
18, to repair the prisoners when the prisoners to talk about the problem of garrison, early in prison that those who sprinkle the sprinkler who are cults, please release as soon as possible!
19, the recent Granville police arrested many processing criminals, so tonight after the update they will be much higher probability.
20, the recent police launched an anti-sweeping action, gangs converged a lot, so you will be more secure on the street than before. Of course, just some.
21, from the original 3 times a week after the big sword to get the state of the state of the economy increased to 20 times a week before the big sword will be weak and other negative state.
22, due to the recent prison business is booming, after the sale of goods vehicles will be an hour after the arrival of the prison will be harvested and concluded.
